description: Source code implementing platform-specific functions for the VL53L0X sensor in Zephyr OS, including I2C read/write operations and delay handling.

methods.name: VL53L0X_WriteMulti
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes to the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: VL53L0X_ReadMulti
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: VL53L0X_WrByte
methods.description: Writes a byte to a sensor register.

methods.name: VL53L0X_WrWord
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit word to a sensor register.

methods.name: VL53L0X_WrDWord
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit double word to a sensor register.

methods.name: VL53L0X_UpdateByte
methods.description: Reads a byte, modifies it with AND/OR masks, and writes back.

methods.name: VL53L0X_RdByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from a sensor register.

methods.name: VL53L0X_RdWord
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit word from a sensor register.

methods.name: VL53L0X_RdDWord
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit double word from a sensor register.
